name: Composio
description: Lets a Caisra agent reach the person's apps — Gmail, Slack, Notion, GitHub and the rest — through Composio, which holds the sign-ins.

apiKey.description: The person's Composio API key. Written as an env placeholder; never the key itself.

userId.description: The Composio user the sign-ins belong to. One computer, one person: 'default'.
